home.chooseProvider: Choose a provider or teach the app how your website works.
home.missingProvider: The website for this saved episode is not configured. Add it or choose another provider.
home.openEpisode: Open an episode to start tracking.
home.activatePlayer: Tap the player placeholder or Play button to start tracking.
home.waitingPlayer: Tap the player placeholder or Play button. Waiting for the primary video to appear.
home.pressPlay: Player detected. Press Play to start tracking.
home.trackingHelp: If progress is not tracking, select the site’s primary player. If you already have, the site may not be supported. Edit this provider to retest.
home.inaccessiblePlayer: This embedded player cannot be tracked on this device. Update Android System WebView and retry.
home.saveProgressFailed: Could not save playback progress. Your previous history is preserved; choose Reload to retry.
provider.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this provider?
provider.name: Provider name
provider.homepageHelp: Paste the homepage URL from your browser. HTTPS is added if you leave it out.
provider.aliasHelp: Only add other website addresses that this provider should be allowed to open. Separate addresses with commas. Embedded players do not need an alias.
provider.onlyStartupHelp: Your only website opens automatically. Add another website to choose a startup preference.
provider.startupHelp: Open on startup chooses the website shown when the app launches.
provider.historyKept: Your watch history will be kept.
provider.noneHelp: Add a website to set up playback tracking.
provider.discardHelp: Your unfinished setup will be lost.
provider.missing: This provider no longer exists. Close this screen and create a new provider.
provider.deleted: This provider was deleted. Create a new provider instead.
provider.loadFailed: Could not load providers. Close this screen and try again.
provider.saveFailed: Could not save. Your setup is still here; try again.
provider.savedHelp: Your website is ready to open.
browser.loadFailed: Could not load the website. Check your connection and choose Reload.
navigation.unsupportedLink: This link is not an HTTP or HTTPS website address.
navigation.approveFailed: Could not save the approved website address. The page stayed blocked. Try again.
watch.removeConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this anime from the list?
watch.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear your entire watch history?
backup.restoreConfirm: Are you sure to restore the previous backup? This will override your current data.
backup.exportFailedHelp: Check that storage is available and try again.
backup.exportHelp: Series names, episode progress, and completion status only.
creator.reviewPassed: Both example pages passed. Ready to save.
creator.selectHint: Select the requested information on the website.
creator.websiteHint: Enter a name and website address.
creator.playbackHint: Play the episode to verify progress. Checking automatic resume is optional.
creator.reviewHint: Review the example pages before saving.
creator.unknownTotalHelp: Total not announced yet. Progress tracking will still work.
creator.selectionGood: Selection looks good. Continue when the preview matches the website.
creator.addExamplesHelp: Add two example pages to verify this provider.
creator.unverifiedHelp: This provider has unverified video features. Return to Video test to retry or explicitly acknowledge the limitations.
playback.activateHelp: Tap the website’s player placeholder or Play button. We’ll detect the video when it appears. If several players appear, choose the primary one.
playback.inaccessibleHelp: This device cannot inspect embedded players. Update Android System WebView and retry.
playback.pausedHelp: Player detected. Press Play on the website to verify progress tracking.
playback.verifiedHelp: Playback tracking is ready. Continue to Review. You can also check automatic resume in Video options.
playback.resumeFailed: Resume could not be verified. You can continue with progress tracking or retry.
playback.resumeUnavailable: Automatic resume is not available yet. You can continue once progress is verified.
playback.resumeExplain: This check briefly seeks one second, then restores the playback position. It is not required to continue.
playback.progressVerifiedHelp: Progress tracking is verified. Automatic resume is an optional check in Video options.
playback.unsupportedHelp: Tap the player placeholder, choose the site’s primary player, and press Play. If you have done that and it still cannot be verified, this site may not be supported.
playback.framesHelp: Some embedded frames are not reporting a video yet. Activate the primary player and retry.
playback.limitationsHelp: If you save anyway, playback progress and automatic resume may not work. Some embedded players do not expose a trackable video.
validation.websiteAddress: Enter a website address, such as https://example.com.
validation.httpOnly: Only HTTP and HTTPS website addresses can be approved.
validation.name: Enter a provider name.
validation.saveExamples: Choose two example pages before saving.
validation.readFailed: The page could not be read.
validation.verifyOrAcknowledge: Return to Playback tracking to verify progress, or acknowledge the limitations before saving.
validation.pageOrAlias: Choose pages on the website or an approved alias.
validation.pageOnWebsite: Choose a page on this website.
validation.duplicatePage: This page is already selected. Open a different series.
runtime.unreadableSelection: This selection cannot be read. Choose it again.
runtime.chooseTotal: Choose one total episode count containing a number or an unknown marker such as ?? or TBA.
runtime.chooseEpisodes: Choose episode numbers from the same list. Each must contain a distinct number.
runtime.pageTimeout: The page did not finish loading. Check the website and retry this example.
steps.title: Series title
instructions.website: Give this website a name and paste its homepage address.
instructions.examples: Open a series page and choose “Use this page”. Repeat with a different series.
instructions.title: Choose Select title, then tap the series title on the website.
instructions.episodes: Choose Select episodes, then tap an episode number. We will find the other episodes in its list.
instructions.total: Choose Select total, then tap the announced total, such as “12 episodes”, or an unknown marker such as “??” or “TBA”. It can differ from the episodes listed on this page.
instructions.playback: Open an episode and press Play. We’ll detect playback, including embedded players. If several players appear, choose the episode’s player below.
instructions.review: We’ll check both example pages automatically. Review the results before saving.
browser.httpError: Website returned error {{code}}. Choose Reload to retry.
validation.chooseTitle: Choose the series title on the page.
validation.chooseEpisodes: Choose the episodes on the page.
validation.chooseTotal: Choose the total episodes on the page.
validation.exampleUnchecked: Example {{index}} still needs to be checked. Choose Test example {{index}}.
validation.exampleFailed: Example {{index}} did not pass: {{reason}} Retest this example or edit the selections.
watch.title: Watchlist
watch.emptyHistoryDetail: Play an episode on one of your websites, or add a series manually.
watch.emptySearchDetail: Try a different title or switch to All.
watch.emptyWatchingDetail: Your completed and stopped series are still in All.
anime.nameHelp: Use the title shown on your website.
anime.episodeHelp: The highest episode you have watched. Use 0 if you haven’t started.
anime.episodeInvalid: Enter a whole episode number, 0 or higher.
anime.saveFailed: Could not save your changes. Your entries are still here; try again.
anime.totalHelp: Enter the total number of episodes, or ? if it is unknown.
anime.totalInvalid: Enter a whole number greater than 0, or ? for an unknown total.
instructions.cover: Optional: select the series cover image. The app stores only its URL and uses it behind watchlist items. Skip this step if the website has no cover.
creator.coverMissing: No cover on this page; the plain watchlist background will be used.
runtime.chooseCover: Choose one cover image with a remote URL.
home.saveCoverFailed: Could not save the cover. Reload the website to try again.
backup.saveFailedHelp: Check that storage is available and try again.
